description_for_human: Real-time technical SEO audits, health scores, and developer fix recommendations for any webpage.
description_for_model: Plugin for auditing webpage URLs for technical SEO health. Validates on-page HTML, title tags, meta descriptions, mobile responsiveness, heading hierarchy (H1-H6), SSL/HTTPS transport, and Core Web Vitals indicators using the SEOWebChecker platform (https://seowebchecker.com/).
